question: In which state did the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) successfully test its indigenous Stratospheric Airship Platform on 3 May 2025?
solution: The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** successfully tested its indigenous **Stratospheric Airship Platform** on **3 May 2025**. • The test was conducted in **Madhya Pradesh**, a state in central India known for its favorable geographical and climatic conditions for testing high-altitude platforms. • The Stratospheric Airship Platform is an advanced **high-altitude platform** designed by DRDO for **surveillance, communication, and strategic purposes**. • This indigenous development is a significant milestone in India’s defense capabilities, as it reduces dependence on foreign technology and aligns with the government’s **‘Make in India’ initiative**. • The platform operates at an altitude of over **20 kilometers** in the stratosphere, enabling it to provide seamless **surveillance and communication** over large areas.
